requirement: Return one patient as a read-only projection: demographics, admission/discharge state, treatment outcome, and the nested next-of-kin and treatment-plan collections; a missing or soft-deleted patient is reported as ResourceNotFound.

preconditions.text: The requested patient exists and is live
The patient carries the next-of-kin and treatment relations seeded for the case
The requested id matches no live patient

returns.text: Success with the full patient projection
Next-of-kin and treatment-plan collections are projected when present
Empty collections when the patient has no relations
Failure with ResourceNotFound and a null payload

exception_text: No unhandled exception; a missing or soft-deleted patient is returned as a failed Result
